documents.title: obfsck Crate Architecture
documents.raw_content: obfsck is a Rust crate for obfuscating/redacting sensitive data in log text before LLM analysis. Public API: obfuscate_text(), obfuscate_alert(), ObfuscationLevel, Obfuscator, ObfuscationMap. Core: lib.rs, helpers.rs, secrets.rs, ports.rs. Adapters: regex_patterns.rs, gitleaks.rs. MCP server. Analyzer feature. Binaries: redact, scan, analyzer, api, obfsck-mcp.

documents.title: Session 2026-05-23: Quality and Testing
documents.raw_content: Session work: rustqual score improved 53% to 81% (175 to 63 findings). Removed lazy-regex dependency, replaced with static_regex! macro using OnceLock. Removed walkdir dependency. Core deps 7 to 6, full deps 21 to 19. Extracted magic numbers to named constants across 8 files. Added rustqual.toml config. Applied testing philosophy: 10 proptest property tests (obfuscation invariants, IP classification, level parsing, allowlist bypass), 2 cargo-fuzz targets (fuzz_obfuscate, fuzz_strip_ansi), 14 inline unit tests in helpers.rs. Discovered: pattern evaluation order is load-bearing (IndexMap required, BTreeMap broke golden tests). serde_yml 0.0.12 too immature to replace serde_yaml.

documents.title: Session 2026-08-21: rust-audit fixes, miette error diagnostics, multi-bin demo
documents.raw_content: Ran rust-audit on obfsck. Two P2 findings blocked Debug derivation: AppState held Arc<AlertAnalyzer>, and AlertAnalyzer held Box<dyn LogClient> and Box<dyn LlmProvider> trait objects that did not implement Debug. Fixed by adding Debug as a supertrait on LogClient and LlmProvider, deriving Debug on OllamaProvider, and hand-writing Debug impls for OpenAiProvider and AnthropicProvider that redact the api_key field instead of deriving it (deriving would have leaked the key in logs). This unblocked deriving Debug on AlertAnalyzer and AppState. Committed as 0da6931. Then added miette as a dependency with the fancy feature. Replaced ports::Result<T> = Result<T, Box<dyn Error>> with a concrete PortsError enum (Spawn, Io, Config, Other variants) deriving thiserror::Error and miette::Diagnostic, closing a C-GOOD-ERR audit finding. GitleaksAdapter::scan_diff and the scan binary's ObfsckScanner now construct PortsError variants directly. AnalyzerError and ApiError also derive miette::Diagnostic with diagnostic codes and help text. Committed as 7f05108. Then wired miette::Report rendering into the bin mains: redact's main now returns miette::Result<()> using IntoDiagnostic/WrapErr on every fallible site; analyzer and api keep tracing::error! for structured logs and additionally print a miette::Report to stderr; scan prints a miette::Report for PortsError from either scanner; obfsck-mcp was left untouched because it is a JSON-RPC stdio protocol server and must not emit human-formatted diagnostic text. Committed as f2ce9a0. Rebuilt release binaries and installed redact, analyzer, api, obfsck-mcp, and scan to ~/.local/bin (scan also refreshed in ~/.cargo/bin since that is what resolves on PATH). Finally extended demo/demo.py (a rich-based Python demo script) with a --bin flag ({redact,scan,mcp,analyzer,api,all}) so it showcases every obfsck binary: scan runs a synthetic diff containing an AWS access key through the native scanner; mcp sends tools/list and a tools/call audit request over JSON-RPC stdio; analyzer runs --dry-run against an unreachable Loki URL to show the new miette fancy diagnostic chain; api starts the axum server on a free port and hits /health and /. Added a repo-local .obfsck.toml allowlisting the AWS example access key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE so the pre-commit scan-diff hook does not flag the demo fixture. Committed as a0b601b.
